objective: Close the remaining reviewer and security findings for public tauri_dialog by making explicit authorization mandatory, clearing authority on every non-success path, rejecting contradictory or surface-unbound provider dialogs, allowlisting public results, and adding complete regression coverage.
closed_decisions: Every accept/cancel MCP call requires authorize=true; authorize=false returns bounded denied state before detecting, authorizing, or deciding.

Native dialog authority is cleared whenever detection is non-supported or lacks valid private metadata, authorization cannot bind a concrete instance, surface proof is missing/mismatched, grant consumption fails, provider decision is non-supported, or postcondition verification is noncanonical.

A retained private dialog requires state supported, concrete providerDialog and public dialog metadata, a non-empty instance id, and a non-empty surfaceRef; contradictory provider responses fail closed.

WebDriverClient public dialog projection omits provider surfaceRef; providerDialog remains private for exact binding. NativeDialogSession explicitly allowlists every returned decision field and never spreads adapter objects.
Post-decision success requires exactly unavailable/provider_dialog_absent/no retained instance; direct tests cover unsupported, failed, malformed, other unavailable, unchanged, and replaced outcomes.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit files outside the six owned files.
Do not change tool names/schema, provider routes or vendored Rust, installer, packaging, custody, dependencies, manifests, lockfiles, queue/blocker/release files, git, Jira, or pull requests.
Do not preserve a grant after any non-success path and do not accept a dialog without an exact provider surface binding.
Do not expose provider instance ids, surface refs, grants, nonces, paths, raw causes, unexpected enumerable adapter fields, or expected/current binding values.

acceptance_criteria.description: Runtime rejects accept/cancel with authorize=false before any dialog dependency call; authorize=true requires a supported concrete current dialog.
NativeDialogSession clears grants on every detection, binding, consumption, provider-decision, and postcondition non-success path, preventing later reuse.
Contradictory provider states and missing/empty surface binding fail closed; public client/session projections omit provider surfaceRef and allowlist all result fields.

Tests directly cover authorize=false, stale-grant reuse, contradictory state, missing surface proof, result-field injection, and all canonical/noncanonical post-decision classes; focused tests and build pass.
